name: Venkat Rangan
current_role: Co-founder and founding CTO, Clari (now merged with Salesloft; combined company operates under the Salesloft brand)
profile: Indian-born engineer (IIT Madras; MS computer science, University of Miami) who co-founded revenue-forecasting SaaS Clari with Andy Byrne in 2012-13 and served as CTO. Earlier co-founded e-discovery firm Clearwell Systems (acquired by Symantec in 2011). Clari merged with Salesloft in 2025; his current operating title post-merger was not confirmed.
interesting_fact: Before Clari he co-founded and was CTO of e-discovery company Clearwell Systems, which Symantec acquired in 2011.
deep_cut_fact: He first met his Clari co-founder Andy Byrne in the late 1990s at VitalSigns Software, a network-diagnostics startup where Rangan was an engineer and Byrne got his first product management job (1997).
notes: Low public profile; Clari now operates as Salesloft (Steve Cox CEO). Best route likely via LinkedIn or Salesloft/Clari press team. No personal published email found.

name: Ikkjin Ahn
profile: Korean-born ML engineer (BS Seoul National University; MSE UPenn) who worked at Google/YouTube before co-founding Moloco in 2013. Moloco builds machine-learning performance advertising for mobile apps and commerce media and has been reported to be weighing an IPO.
interesting_fact: At Google he developed YouTube's video profitability prediction system; that work on early YouTube monetization revealed the ML-for-mobile-ads opportunity that led to Moloco.
deep_cut_fact: He was the founding Tech Lead Manager of Google's Android Data team before leaving to start Moloco with a small team of ML engineers.
notes: Moloco's PR team publishes a dedicated how-to-contact page; press route is the best bet.

name: Abhinav Shashank
profile: IIT Kharagpur graduate who co-founded Innovaccer (with Kanav Hasija and Sandeep Gupta) as a data analytics startup and pivoted it to healthcare around 2016. Innovaccer, based in San Francisco, became India-origin's first healthtech unicorn and now sells an AI/data platform and agents for US health systems.
interesting_fact: Named to Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia 2017 (Enterprise Tech) and has published 300+ articles in international media outlets.
deep_cut_fact: He and co-founder Kanav Hasija were IIT Kharagpur batchmates who graduated in 2010; Abhinav then spent about three years at Ingersoll (Rand) working alongside future co-founder Sandeep Gupta before starting the company.
notes: Active on LinkedIn and frequent media contributor; press team handles interview requests.

name: Wally Ibrahim
current_role: Technical co-founder and CTO, Aloi (integrations platform); co-founder and former CTO of project44
profile: Chicago technologist who co-founded supply-chain visibility platform project44 with Jett McCandless in 2014 and served as its CTO (until about 2018). He has since been CTO and co-founder of Aloi, a platform for building and sharing business integrations. project44 has been valued at about $2.7B.
interesting_fact: Co-founded project44 in Chicago in 2014 with CEO Jett McCandless; project44 grew into one of the leading real-time freight/supply-chain visibility platforms.
notes: Low public profile; sources are mostly third-party profiles (Crunchbase, MarketScreener). No published contact found; LinkedIn likely the only route. Not currently at project44 (CEO is Jett McCandless).

name: Xavier Durand
current_role: Co-founder of Aircall (left the company in late 2020); current role not found
profile: French engineer with front-end development expertise who co-founded cloud phone-system company Aircall in 2014 at the eFounders startup studio in Paris, alongside Olivier Pailhes, Jonathan Anguelov and Pierre-Baptiste Bechu. Aircall became eFounders' first unicorn in 2020; Durand left in late 2020.
interesting_fact: Aircall's founders went through the 500 Startups 2015 batch in San Francisco, then raised $2.75M; within five months the team grew from 5 to 15 and turnover tripled.
deep_cut_fact: When Aircall struggled with hiring and fundraising, Durand moved to New York with CEO Olivier Pailhes while the technical team stayed in Paris -- a split that became a blueprint for French founders building in the US.
notes: Very low public profile and no longer at Aircall; contact@aircall.io is a company address, not his. LinkedIn is likely the only route.
